asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
mov     [rbp+a], edi
mov     [rbp+c], esi
mov     [rbp+m], edx
mov     [rbp+x], rcx
cvtsi2ss xmm0, [rbp+a]
mov     rax, [rbp+x]
movss   xmm2, dword ptr [rax]
cvtsi2ss xmm1, [rbp+c]
mulss   xmm0, xmm2
addss   xmm0, xmm1
movss   [rbp+num], xmm0
movss   xmm0, [rbp+num]
cvtsi2ss xmm1, [rbp+m]
divss   xmm0, xmm1
cvttss2si eax, xmm0
mov     [rbp+num_mod], eax
movss   xmm0, [rbp+num]
mov     eax, [rbp+num_mod]
imul    eax, [rbp+m]
cvtsi2ss xmm1, eax
subss   xmm0, xmm1
movss   [rbp+num], xmm0
movss   xmm0, [rbp+num]
cvtsi2ss xmm1, [rbp+m]
divss   xmm0, xmm1
mov     rax, [rbp+x]
movss   dword ptr [rax], xmm0
mov     rax, [rbp+x]
movss   xmm0, dword ptr [rax]
pop     rbp
retn
